recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-17830 unless the work group separately reopens the later FHIR-34396 wording decision.
issue_request: FHIR-17830 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request for STU3 AllergyIntolerance.recordedDate. It asked that the description stop saying only "Date record was first recorded" and instead match the definition more closely; the approved resolution was to use "Date first version of the resource instance was recorded".
initial_application: Commit 577f01a788a2 applied FHIR-17830 to the then-authoritative AllergyIntolerance spreadsheet by changing the description to "Date first version of the resource instance was recorded". The current source no longer contains that spreadsheet, but the current AllergyIntolerance-date search parameter still has the approved phrase and the old phrase is absent from current AllergyIntolerance source.
additional_context: AllergyIntolerance is active in source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition short is "Date allergy or intolerance was first recorded" and its definition/comment text explains that recordedDate is when this particular record was created in the system, with guidance on preserving a sender-provided recordedDate or using receipt timestamp when absent. Later Published issue FHIR-34396 explicitly approved that short text and comments, citing related Condition recordedDate/recorder alignment work; commit e729df8464 applied it, and 2021-12-16 Patient Care minutes list FHIR-34396 as resolved.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Replacing the current StructureDefinition short with the exact FHIR-17830 phrase would undo the later FHIR-34396 decision, while the current search parameter preserves the original approved phrase and the current element definition/comment text still conveys the intended first-recorded semantics.
